name: notes-desk-editor
description: Live-preview markdown editor bundled into the Notes Desk page. Run `npm run build` after changing src/.

scripts.build: esbuild src/editor.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --global-name=NotesEditor --target=es2020 --legal-comments=eof --outfile=../assets/editor.bundle.js "--banner:js=/* Notes Desk editor. Bundles CodeMirror 6 and Lezer, MIT License, Copyright (C) 2018-2021 by Marijn Haverbeke and others. */"
